name: Kalopsia: Let's Descend Together
source:
A new city brings uncertainty. Everything feels foreign, and yet you are caught in the orbit of five hearts, five minds that remember you… though you do not remember them. Perhaps there is beauty in the chaos – or perhaps it will claim you.

[From [url=https://stubbedt0e.itch.io/kalopsia-lets-descend-together]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新城市带来不确定性。一切都感觉很陌生，然而你却被困在五颗心、五颗记得你的头脑的轨道上……尽管你不记得他们了。也许混乱中蕴含着美丽——或者也许它会夺走你。

[来自[url=https://stubbedt0e.itch.io/kalopsia-lets-descend-together]Itch.io[/url]]
